newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pemex says two crude ports closed.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pemex says two crude ports closed.

text.p: A spokeswoman for the state-owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Tuesday that two important crude ports in the Gulf of Mexico are closed because of bad weather.
"Pajaritos and Dos Bocas are still closed, but Cayo Arcos is open," the spokeswoman said, refering to the three main Pemex terminals in the Gulf.
Bad weather is shrouding the Gulf because of the proximity of Tropical Storm Josephine.
She gave no indication of when the two ports might re-open, although port captains in charge of shipping movements tend to wait for weather systems to be well out of sight before re-opening.
Josephine, although moving away from Mexico, has dumped heavy rains and whipped up high seas in the Gulf coast areas.

Mexico's Communications and Transportation Ministry said a total of seven main ports were closed Monday because of the bad weather. Two of them listed were Dos Bocas and Coatzocoalcos which controls Pajaritos.
